messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Content Access" as it appears in the following examples.
['A copy of your offer letter will be sent to you for future reference.', 'Please visit our Customer Confirmation Page using the link below and follows the instructions on the screen.', 'To see all quarantined messages view your email quarantine (link is external) or continue below.', 'To complete the form, please use the link below:', 'To read this message, follow the link below:http://www.facebook.com/n/?inbox/readmessage.php&t=1992609198061&mid=39e67e754f848bb6737535e9b334e712&n_m=facebook messages message was intended for you.', 'To ensure that you are protected from the latest fraudulent scam and other account threats, it\'s strongly advised that you should update account protection click on "Protection" to continue the process...', 'To complete the form, please use the link below: NatWest Customer Form', 'To read this message, follow the link below:http://www.facebook.com/n/?inbox/readmessage.php&t=1074002939922&mid=1be248fd30be8488fe7c7d24e5de1dac&n_m=facebook information', 'To access the form please click on the following link:', 'The terms of buying sign up you can find here: Terms and Conditions', 'To continue to have access to this service, you must reactivate your account.', 'Your W-2 is ready for viewing under Employee Self Service.', 'Please visit our Customer Confirmation Page using the link below and follow the instructions on the screen.', 'By clicking on the link below please begin the form of the client details approval: http://www1.an-business.net/servlet/?ref=30dbczyencrDwcjjtlctOldbhrOkhOvp', 'Please visit our Client Verification Form using the link below and follow the instructions on the screen.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
